title: Hamilton Revised: The Action Principle for Initial Value Problems
summary: We present the variational action principle for initial value problems in classical, conservative-force point particle mechanics. We rigorously derive this formulation by taking the classical limit of the Schwinger-Keldysh expression for the time dependence of the expectation value for operators in quantum mechanics. We clarify the connection between the variation of the position and the variation of the velocity of a particle when implementing Hamilton's Principle in deriving the Euler-Lagrange Equations.
